title: the SQL toggle on a no-text stream shows "no text fields" and stays in filter mode
verifies: Toggling SQL on the int-only nofts_c stream reverts to filter mode and shows the "This stream has no text fields to search." refusal panel, with the editor left at the bare word.

title: the SQL toggle on a held NOT timeout filter shows "empty or invalid" and stays in filter mode
verifies: Toggling SQL on a held NOT timeout filter reverts SQL mode to false, shows the "Search query is empty or invalid." notification, and leaves the editor unchanged (no SELECT / match_all).
